download_imagenet_sketch_dataset: download the ImageNet-Sketch dataset archive and extract it to a specified root directory
create_imagenet_sketch_data_files: create VISSL-compatible classification dataset files from ImageNet-Sketch input folder
cleanup_unused_dataset_files: cleanup unused zip and images folders after converting dataset to VISSL format
get_imagenet_sketch_argument_parser: get an argparse argument parser with input, output, and download flags for the script
remove_file_name_whitespace: remove whitespace from file names in the ImageNet-Sketch input directory
